verdict: Strong 28-day ROAS, but purchases have stalled the last six days.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads returned $3.86 for every $1.00 spent, driven by a concentrated run of 24 purchases and $5,781.63 in revenue. However, the last six days recorded zero purchases and zero revenue — the strong 28-day number reflects earlier momentum, not current pace. At the same moment, Google Business Profile engagement fell 28% week-over-week, with two days of zero local actions, which suggests the slowdown is not limited to paid alone. We are monitoring the purchase signal closely and keeping daily spend steady while we assess whether this is a short gap or a trend shift; creative development — including facility footage — is being advanced to give the campaigns fresh material heading into September.

watch_item.issue: Purchases have gone to zero for six consecutive days after a strong mid-period run — the 28-day ROAS is real but its sustainability is unconfirmed.
watch_item.fix: Daily spend and campaign settings are being held steady while purchase data is reviewed day by day; new creative assets are being prioritised to re-engage the audience before the end of August.
